We are rooted in a strong culture and shared core values. We care about our team, our customers, and each other. If you’re someone who has a passion for advancing business and improving lives through technology, values trust, integrity, and a place where your contributions matter, you’ll feel right at home here.

The **Technical Alignment Manager (TAM) -** is responsible for understanding the client’s environment, what they do, how they use their technology to enable their business, and, from a technical perspective, maintaining that relationship with them. Establishing a technical relationship with the clients allows the TAM to communicate from a hands-on level. jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Own the controls and estimation architecture for a precision laser beam director within a defense technology team. Your work will help stabilize and accurately aim the system at dynamic targets, from algorithm design through outdoor testing.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design the coarse gimbal and fine steering mirror control architecture, including bandwidth allocation, multi-rate design, and handoffs.
* Develop target state estimators that fuse radar, EO/IR, and inertial data, with latency compensation built in.
* Implement line-of-sight stabilization and jitter rejection using inertial stabilization, feedforward, and adaptive filtering.
* Set pointing error budgets and validate microradian precision against dynamic targets in field testing.
* Model system dynamics and identify plant behavior, then validate models through hardware-in-the-loop testing and simulation.
* Analyze stability, robustness, sensitivity, and performance under disturbances and parameter variation.
* Integrate cue-to-track-to-engage logic, engagement sequencing, dwell maintenance, and safety interlocks.
* Move algorithms from simulation to embedded hardware, implementing real-time control loops and reviewing controls and sensor integration.
* Serve as a technical anchor and mentor engineers through hands-on technical leadership.

### **What We're Looking For**

* 10 or more years closing loops on precision pointing, tracking, or stabilization hardware, with demonstrated field performance against measured specifications.
* A PhD in control systems, electrical, mechanical, or aerospace engineering, applied mathematics, or a related field, with research in control or estimation; alternatively, an MS with research-grade theory work applied to fielded hardware.
* Hands-on experience with microradian-class line-of-sight systems, such as beam directors, fine steering mirrors, gimbaled sensors, laser communications terminals, telescopes, spacecraft pointing, or equivalent precision mechatronics.
* Expertise in robust control and estimation, including H-infinity, mu-synthesis, LQG, Kalman filtering, IMM, nonlinear observers, and multi-rate or sampled-data design.
* Experience with system identification, structural dynamics, real-time hardware-in-the-loop validation, and embedded C or C++ control loops on RTOS targets.
* Ability to work on-site in San Francisco, U.S. citizenship, and ability to obtain a security clearance.
* Directed energy, adaptive optics, atmospheric propagation, or beam wander experience, and relevant publications or patents, are helpful.

### **Compensation & Benefits**

Base salary: $250,000 to $315,000 annually. Equity and visa sponsorship details were not provided.

### **Location**

On-site in San Francisco, United States.

Compensation Range: $250K - $315K

--------------------

Come be a part of a fast-paced, fulfilling and fun team in beautiful Colorado Springs, CO! We have an exciting new opportunity providing Advisory and Assistance Services (A&AS) supporting the US Space Force mission to defend National Security Interests in Space as a **Space Domain Awareness (SDA) Radar Systems Engineer** providing Engineering Support as a member of the Deep Space Advanced Radar Capability (DARC) program in Space Systems Command (SSC), System Delta 85 (SYD 85).

  

SYD 85 is the U.S. Space Force organization responsible for developing and delivering resilient space capabilities supporting Battle Management, Command, Control, Communication, and Space Intelligence (BMC3I). SYD 85 synchronizes acquisition efforts for critical space system capabilities and works together with Combat Forces Command (CFC) Mission Deltas to improve mission readiness.

  

SYD 85 contains three System Program Directors (SPDs), formerly known as Senior Materiel Leaders, corresponding to Battlespace Awareness (BA), Battle Management (BM), and Space Access & Networked Services (BN). The DARC program is under Battlespace Awareness, Ground Sensors (SSC SYD85/BAS).

  

Odyssey provides support to the Government in five areas: Product Support, Sustainment Engineering & Sustainment Management, Technical Order Management, Technical User Interface, and System Design, Engineering, and Integration. These tasks are executed laterally with USSF CFC depot and development contractors and with BMC3I stakeholders.

  

This is a full-time position at 2424 Garden of the Gods Road with occasional work at Peterson SFB and Schriever SFB in Colorado Springs, CO and the opportunity to telework 1 to 2 days per week at the discretion of the Government.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

An A&AS contractor is a knowledgeable and trusted advisor to the Government Program Office. As an **SDA Radar** **Systems Engineer** you will perform engineering analysis, planning, interface design, and provide engineering support for programs in SYD 85. The ideal candidate will be an engineer who can rapidly become educated on Radio Frequency (RF), hardware implementation, and digital signal processing issues for the new DARC system, evaluate the cost/benefit of many potential technical solutions, and make recommendations to the Delta or the PAE for how to proceed. You will also create plans for future development and integration of SYD 85 systems. Duties include, but are not limited to:

* Organize and lead integrated product teams (IPT) to review and resolve technical issues or risks to product delivery
* Provide systems, electrical, and/or mechanical engineering support for new Space Force systems
* Review and approve radar focused technical deliverables including (Algorithm Description Documentation (ADD), Test plans and procedures, Technical Orders and engineering drawing packages
* Review, organize and manage the technical baseline of SYD-85 developed weapon systems using modern tools including Model Based Systems Engineering (MBSE)
* Manage, analyze, and trace functional and non-functional system requirements, and architecture components
* Draft and/or review engineering documents (SEP, RMP, CMP, LCMP, PPP etc.) to ensure best engineering practices are implemented
* Identify and track development risks in support of Government activities
* Develop technology insertion and risk reduction strategies, studies, and recommendations to mitigate identified risks

### **About the Role**

Own the controls and estimation architecture for a precision laser beam director within a defense technology team. Your work will help stabilize and accurately aim the system at dynamic targets, from algorithm design through outdoor testing.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design the coarse gimbal and fine steering mirror control architecture, including bandwidth allocation, multi-rate design, and handoffs.
* Develop target state estimators that fuse radar, EO/IR, and inertial data, with latency compensation built in.
* Implement line-of-sight stabilization and jitter rejection using inertial stabilization, feedforward, and adaptive filtering.
* Set pointing error budgets and validate microradian precision against dynamic targets in field testing.
* Model system dynamics and identify plant behavior, then validate models through hardware-in-the-loop testing and simulation.
* Analyze stability, robustness, sensitivity, and performance under disturbances and parameter variation.
* Integrate cue-to-track-to-engage logic, engagement sequencing, dwell maintenance, and safety interlocks.
* Move algorithms from simulation to embedded hardware, implementing real-time control loops and reviewing controls and sensor integration.

* Hands-on experience with microradian-class line-of-sight systems, such as beam directors, fine steering mirrors, gimbaled sensors, laser communications terminals, telescopes, spacecraft pointing, or equivalent precision mechatronics.
* Expertise in robust control and estimation, including H-infinity, mu-synthesis, LQG, Kalman filtering, IMM, nonlinear observers, and multi-rate or sampled-data design.

On-site in San Francisco, United States.

Meta is investing heavily on the Meta Cloud. As part of this push we want to build a cloud-native infrastructure optimized for AI development. As part of the Meta Compute Initiative, we’re evolving this foundation to support a cloud-native, Kubernetes-first AI infrastructure—including platform primitives like network virtualization, load balancing/service connectivity, and distributed firewall/policy enforcement—at Meta scale. This is a chance to lead architecture and delivery while influencing a broad cross-functional ecosystem, leveraging (and contributing to) open source where it helps us move faster. We build the platform layer and partner closely with the many application teams that run on top.  
  
  

### **Software Engineer, Endpoint Networking (Technical Leadership) Responsibilities:**

* Architect and lead delivery of Meta Compute’s cloud-native host networking platform, owning end-to-end technical direction from design through production rollout
* Build/modernize Kubernetes networking features integrated with Meta’s host networking stack (e.g., dataplane integration, operability, scaling characteristics)
* Design and implement core networking primitives: network virtualization, load balancing/service connectivity, and distributed firewalling/policy enforcement
* Drive time-to-market execution: define milestones, de-risk key technical choices early and deliver iterative production increments
* Lead broad cross-functional alignment across compute, storage, platform, security, and hardware/fabric partners—owning interfaces/contracts and end-to-end outcomes
* Leverage and influence open-source ecosystems: evaluate open-source building blocks, contribute improvements where needed, and ensure Meta’s solution is maintainable and operable long-term

  
  
  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 10+ years of experience in software development for networking or infrastructure systems, or PhD with 4+ years of experience in a relevant technical area
* 4+ years proven experience designing and shipping networking dataplane/control-plane systems in production (e.g., host networking, L4/L7 load balancing, NAT/conntrack, firewalls/policy, network virtualization)
* Hands-on Kubernetes networking experience in production (e.g., CNI, Services, NetworkPolicy/policy models, service connectivity/load balancing integration)
* Proficiency in C/C++ and at least one scripting language (Python/Shell Scripting)
* Experience with developing and automating test suites
* Demonstrated experience working across disciplines to align on technical decisions and deliver integrated solutions

  
  
  

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Direct experience with DPU SoC/SmartNIC Platforms
* Expertise in high-performance networking frameworks and techniques such as DPDK, eBPF/XDP, AF\_XDP, io\_uring, kernel bypass, zero-copy I/O, and RDMA/RoCEv2
* Experience in hyperscale or cloud-provider environments
* Experience collaborating closely with hardware and ASIC design teams, contributing to hardware specifications, co-designing hardware-software interfaces, and influencing silicon feature sets based on software requirements
* Experience building or contributing to Kubernetes operators, controllers, or device plugins that manage hardware-accelerated networking or storage resources
* Familiarity with Linux networking internals such as netdev subsystem, TC/iptables/nftables, network namespace isolation, traffic shaping, and kernel driver development
